title: Google Photos Extensions
imageAlt: Before and after diagram from Instant Swap for Google Photos: without the extension two photos overlap during the slide, with it one clean photo shows
description: *Instant Swap for Google Photos* is a **Chrome extension, published on the Chrome Web Store**. It removes the slide between photos, so the arrow keys flip cleanly between two photos to compare them. I use it every day.

It is part of a **family of extensions** for what Google Photos cannot do in bulk: [Location Check](https://github.com/guplem/google-photos-location-check) marks photos with no location, [auto Save Check](https://github.com/guplem/google-photos-auto-save-check) marks unsaved shared-album photos, and [auto Fav](https://github.com/guplem/google-photos-auto-fav) and [auto Date](https://github.com/guplem/google-photos-auto-date) apply favourites and date fixes from a file.
They read the page the way a person does, with **no Google API**, and nothing leaves the browser.
